title: hunch task verify recorded exit_code null for every npm/npx command on Windows (spawn without shell cannot start .cmd launchers)
observation: Observed 2026-09-14/15 on Windows 11. runReportCheck spawned the user's argv with shell:false; on Windows `npx`, `npm` and any other launcher that is really a .cmd/.bat shim cannot start that way, the child 'error' event was settled as exit_code null with an empty output hash, and every contribution card on this machine read 'No independent command result recorded' even when the agent had run the suite through `hunch task verify`. RESOLVED in 7a13375 (PR #240): src/core/spawnCommand.ts resolves npm/npx to their npm-cli.js/npx-cli.js run by the current Node (no shell), .exe files via PATHEXT directly, and .cmd/.bat shims through cmd.exe /d /s /c with a pre-quoted line; a launch failure is now hashed into stderr and streamed as 'hunch: could not start <cmd>: <error>'. Verified live: `hunch task verify … -- npx tsx --test test/state-kinds.test.ts` records exit_code 0. Related harness defect fixed in the same change: under the tsx test runner on Windows import.meta.resolve('tsx') returns a bare path, Node rejects the c: scheme on --import, and every CLI-spawning test failed locally (test/helpers.ts tsxLoaderUrl()).
evidence: before: hunch task verify <id> -- npx tsx --test test/state-kinds.test.ts -> exit_code: null, output_hash of empty streams
after 7a13375: same command -> exit_code: 0; test/spawn-command.test.ts 5/5 incl. real npx --version on win32; hook/status/report/record/drift suites 65/65 locally
src/core/taskReportEvidence.ts spawn(command[0], …, { shell: false }) was the failing call
